title: 第15章 我喊个屁第16章 饕餮丹火
lines: 洞府内。
双膝跪在地上的萧焰，根本不敢说话。
这次真的是偷鸡不成蚀把米，甚至还让师父丢人。
“从现在开始，你给我好好修炼，争取早日筑基，然后光明正大的去挑战他，他既然想死，我们就成全他。”
“这里是百枚聚灵丹，就算是用丹药堆积，你也要给我堆起来。”
“多谢师父成全。”
离开生死台。
林铮看着走在前面的身影，不得不承认，火魅长老的身材真的没的说，凹凸有致。
“惹了雷繁，你以后会有很多麻烦，他不单单是护犊子，更是小人一个，阴险狡诈，不会放过你。”
“有火魅长老守着，我不怕他。”
重重咯嗯哼一声，火魅停下转身，狠狠地瞪了一眼，怒道：“暗箭难防，他是长老，你只是弟子，他想要对付你太容易了。”
“火魅长老有办法？”
“没有。”
火魅低头沉思了一会，问道：“对炼丹感兴趣吗？”
“算是感兴趣，当初我在三焱城的时候，接触过炼丹，算是半个炼丹师。”
“随我来。”
林铮有些好奇，不知道火魅到底想要带自己去哪里，甚至突然提起炼丹师是什么意思。
僻静的庭院内，到处都是种植园，里面种植着各种不认识的灵草。
“我认识那株鸡冠红，三焱城有人出售上万枚灵石，竟然在这里有种植，还不止一株，而是整整五株。”
“土包子。”
火魅看向不远处的炼丹房，说道：“火玄，出来。”
石门打开，一位驼背男子走了出来，头发乱糟糟，很是不满道：“火魅，我可是你大哥，你竟然连大哥都不喊，成何体统。”
“我喊个屁。”
火玄走到火魅面前，也不在意，笑着说道：“今天怎么有空来我这里了。”
“帮你找个弟子。”
“你是不是搞错了，我从来不收徒。”
“这次必须收。”
“为何？”
火魅想了想，还是说道：“他招惹了雷繁，唯有拜你为师，雷繁才不敢动他，否则的话，他活不过一个月。”
“他是生是死，和我没有关系。”
“你必须收。”
有些惊讶，火玄看向面前青年，问道：“叫什么名字。”
“林铮。”
“小子，想要成为炼丹师，首先要测试你的元神和控火能力，要是无法达到我的要求。”
不等火玄把话说完，火魅转身就走，不耐烦的说道：“你必须收他。”
满脸的苦涩，火玄埋怨道：“天天给我甩脸子，好像我欠你的一样。”
“小子，随我来。”
林铮很是惊讶，他也没有想到火魅会带着自己前来拜师，炼丹师在东荒的地位相当高。
进入炼丹房。
火玄手里出现一颗水晶球，通体淡白色，说道：“将你的元神灌入测试球内，赤橙黄绿青蓝紫，只要测试球呈现出黄色，便算你通过测试。”
content_en:
Inside the cave.
Xiao Yan, who was kneeling on the ground, did not dare to speak at all.
This time it was really a waste of money and even made the master look embarrassed.
"From now on, you should practice hard for me, strive to build a foundation as soon as possible, and then challenge him openly. Since he wants to die, we will help him."
"Yes."
"Here are hundreds of spirit-gathering pills. Even if they are piled with pills, you have to pile them up for me."
"Thank you, Master, for helping me."
Leave the stage of life and death.
Lin Zheng looked at the figure walking in front and had to admit that Elder Huo Mei's figure was indeed very good.
"If you offend Lei Fan, you will be in a lot of trouble in the future. He is not only a protector, but also a villain. He is cunning and will not let you go."
"Elder Huo Mei is guarding me, so I'm not afraid of him."
"Hmph!"
With a heavy grunt, Huo Mei stopped and turned around, glared fiercely, and said angrily: "It's hard to guard against hidden arrows. He is an elder and you are just a disciple. It is too easy for him to deal with you."
"Elder Huo Mei has something to do?"
"No."
Huo Mei lowered her head and thought for a while, then asked: "Are you interested in alchemy?"
"I'm interested. When I was in Sanyan City, I had some exposure to alchemy, and I was considered a half-alchemist."
"Come with me."
Lin Zheng was a little curious, not knowing where Huo Mei wanted to take him, or even what the sudden mention of alchemist meant.
There are plantations everywhere in the secluded courtyard, where various unknown spiritual herbs are planted.
"I know that cockscomb red plant. Someone in Sanyan City sells tens of thousands of spiritual stones, but it is actually planted here. There is not just one plant, but five plants."
"Bumpkin."
Huo Mei looked at the alchemy room not far away and said, "Huo Xuan, come out."
The stone door opened, and a hunchbacked man came out with messy hair. He was very dissatisfied and said: "Huo Mei, I am your eldest brother. You don't even call me eldest brother. How can you behave like this?"
"I yelled shit."
Huo Xuan walked up to Huo Mei and didn't care. He smiled and said, "Why are you free to come to my place today?"
"Find you a disciple."
"Are you mistaken? I never accept disciples."
"It must be collected this time."
"Why?"
Huo Mei thought for a while and then said: "He provoked Lei Fan. Only by worshiping you as his teacher will Lei Fan dare not touch him. Otherwise, he will not live for more than a month."
"Whether he lives or dies has nothing to do with me."
"You must accept it."
Somewhat surprised, Huo Xuan looked at the young man in front of him and asked, "What's your name?"
"Lin Zheng."
"Boy, if you want to become an alchemist, you must first test your soul and fire control ability. If you cannot meet my requirements."
Before Huo Xuan could finish his words, Huo Mei turned around and left, impatiently saying: "You must accept him."
With a face full of bitterness, Huo Xuan complained: "You give me shame every day, as if I owe you."
"Boy, come with me."
Lin Zheng was very surprised. He did not expect that Huo Mei would bring him to become a disciple. The alchemist's status in Donghuang was quite high.
Enter the alchemy room.
A crystal ball appeared in Huo Xuan's hand. It was pale white and said: "Pour your soul into the test ball. It will be red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple. As long as the test ball turns yellow, you will pass the test."
